goals.objective: Implement Active Fedference publication-readiness pass: exhaustive manuscript and output review; Perplexity-backed scholarship lead generation with primary-source verification; integrate only claim-relevant citations and prose; update top-level TODO and scoped TODO pages to reflect readiness status while leaving Major research projects open; regenerate manuscript variables, PDF, web package, release/package artifacts through documented scripts; run full source, manuscript, package, lint, stale-scan, and rendered-surface verification; produce final publication-readiness verdict with evidence. Scope excludes multi-week Major TODO implementation unless a blocker is found.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/data surface: source review and scholarship integration are complete when git diff shows manuscript/bibliography/TODO/publication-facing changes, every added citation appears in live prose, and the ULW research synthesis lists accepted/rejected leads with primary-source URLs
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-research/<session>/SYNTHESIS.md plus git diff -- manuscript README.md TODO.md docs/todo manuscript/references.bib showing claim-relevant changes only
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Scholarship and manuscript claim integration complete: SYNTHESIS.md records accepted/rejected leads with primary-source URLs; references.bib adds only pillutla2022robust and updates FedGVI metadata; manuscript, README, TODO, and docs diff bound claims and remove completed polish backlog.
successCriteria.notes: Accepted sources: PMLR FedGVI, JMLR GVI, DOI-verified Friston belief sharing, arXiv/IEEE robust aggregation. Rejected extra leads as bibliography padding.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI/render surface: regenerated publication outputs are complete when scripts/z_generate_manuscript_variables.py, scripts/02_run_analysis.py as needed, template PDF render/validate/copy, web package preparation/validation, and release/package validation all run or are explicitly proven unnecessary after source edits
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Command transcripts under .omo/evidence/active-fedference-readiness-20260707/ showing successful generation, no unresolved {{TOKEN}} in output/manuscript, valid output/pdf/active_fedference_combined.pdf, valid output/web/index.html, and updated output/release manifest/checksums when outputs change
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Regeneration completed through documented scripts: manuscript variables/output, template PDF render/validate/copy, package preparation/validation, output validation, and release build/verify all passed. PDF is 81 pages; figure registries list 23 figures with no unresolved tokens; release contains 390 artifacts.
successCriteria.notes: Template copy wrote 472 files; validate_all package reported 43 HTML files and 46 assets; build_release --verify passed.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression/manual QA surface: publication readiness is complete when full tests/coverage, manuscript profile, package profile, ruff, git diff checks, stale scans, PDF text spot checks, and web-browser smoke all pass after regeneration
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Transcripts under .omo/evidence/active-fedference-readiness-20260707/ for uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-fail-under=90, uv run python scripts/validate_all.py manuscript, uv run python scripts/validate_all.py package, ruff, git diff --check, stale scans, pdftotext checks, and browser smoke screenshot/action log
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Regression and manual QA complete: full source gate passed 773 tests with coverage gate, manuscript profile passed 38 tests, package profile passed, ruff passed, git diff --check passed, metadata/layer checks passed, stale/PDF/token scans passed, Chrome web smoke passed.
successCriteria.notes: Only residual test-suite note was one PyTorch scalar conversion warning in an existing test; it did not affect publication readiness or coverage.
